tools.name: encircle_list_organizations
tools.description: List the Encircle organizations this API key can see. Run this first to confirm the connection and to see the organization ids. Encircle API: GET /v1/organizations.

tools.name: encircle_list_property_claims
tools.description: List property claims (insurance losses) visible to this key, newest first by default. Filter by the assignment, contractor or insurer identifier, or by policyholder name. Returns a page and a cursor.after value for the next page. Encircle API: GET /v1/property_claims.

tools.name: encircle_get_property_claim
tools.description: Get one property claim: policyholder, address, date and type of loss, insurer, policy number, estimates and the permalink to the Encircle web page. Encircle API: GET /v1/property_claims/{property_claim_id}.

tools.name: encircle_list_structures
tools.description: List the structures (buildings or areas) of a property claim. Use the structure ids with encircle_list_rooms. Encircle API: GET /v1/property_claims/{property_claim_id}/structures.

tools.name: encircle_list_rooms
tools.description: List the rooms of one structure in a property claim. Use the room ids to filter the moisture and dehumidifier readings. Encircle API: GET /v1/property_claims/{property_claim_id}/structures/{structure_id}/rooms.

tools.name: encircle_list_media
tools.description: List the photos, videos and other files attached to a property claim, with download URIs, labels, creator and capture time. Encircle API: GET /v1/property_claims/{property_claim_id}/media.

tools.name: encircle_list_material_readings
tools.description: List the material (moisture) readings of a property claim: moisture content, dry standard, temperature, meter and the room. Encircle API: GET /v2/property_claims/{property_claim_id}/material_readings.

tools.name: encircle_list_dehumidifier_readings
tools.description: List the dehumidifier readings of a property claim: temperature, relative and specific humidity, the equipment and the room. Encircle API: GET /v2/property_claims/{property_claim_id}/dehumidifier_readings.

tools.name: encircle_list_claim_notes
tools.description: List the notes on a property claim, with title, Markdown text, creator and creation time. Encircle API: GET /v2/property_claims/{property_claim_id}/notes.

tools.name: encircle_create_claim_note
tools.description: Create a new note on a property claim. Adds a note; it does not edit or delete existing notes. Give a title, Markdown text, or both. Encircle API: POST /v2/property_claims/{property_claim_id}/notes.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: encircle_get_property_claim · Private data: encircle_list_organizations, encircle_list_media · Public sink: encircle_create_claim_note · Destructive: encircle_list_organizations, encircle_create_claim_note.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: encircle_get_property_claim · Private data: encircle_list_organizations, encircle_list_media · Public sink: encircle_create_claim_note · Destructive: encircle_list_organizations, encircle_create_claim_note

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
